voiceover: Most budgets fail because they need willpower every single day. Here's a system that needs it once. Step one. The day your paycheck lands, an automatic transfer moves your savings out first. Step two. Bills go on autopay from one account. Step three. Whatever is left in your spending account is yours, guilt free. You're not tracking every coffee. You're deciding once, then letting the system run. Set it up in one afternoon. Comment CASH and I'll send you the free template I use to map it out.
ctaText: I’ll DM you the free template
caption: The pay-yourself-first system: 1) savings move out on payday, automatically 2) bills on autopay from one account 3) the rest is guilt-free spending. Decide once, let it run. I'm an AI character. Education only.
